svg.title: Field between two tilted plates
svg.desc: Computed field lines between two conducting plates that are closest together at the left and spread apart toward the right. The top plate is positive and the bottom plate negative. Field lines leave the top plate at right angles and arrive at the bottom plate at right angles, curving between them. The lines are most crowded, and the field strongest, where the plates are closest. Positive charge sits mainly on the lower face of the top plate and negative charge on the upper face of the bottom plate, with the greatest density at the narrow left end and at the corners; little charge is on the outer faces. Fringe lines bulge outward beyond the open right end and around the edges.
